gameName: Star Wars Villainous: Power of the Dark Side
firstPlayerRule: Use the game's playful criterion, whoever last used the Force, or let the oldest player start.
officialTieBreak: Choosing the oldest player is an official alternative, not just a tie-break.
clarifications: The first player starts with no Credits, the second with one, and the third and fourth with two each.

internalEvidence: Starting instructions were checked on rendered publisher pages, including relevant mode context. Publisher source context: https://www.ravensburger.us/en-US/service/game-instructions. Finding: Use the game's playful criterion, whoever last used the Force, or let the oldest player start. Local source SHA-256: c2d1cee36951b35e9988fa4f7fbd6033c1918475f83125c904c5884c328e369c. Setup page 3, credits page 19 and the EN01 back cover were visually inspected. Page 2's clipped spread duplicates some extracted text from page 3, but the actual starting passage is visible on page 3. The oldest-player alternative is connected by or; it is not restricted to a tie. The source identifies the original five-Villain Power of the Dark Side set. Editorial review 2026-09-23: Codex checked the rendered starting passage, edition and source language, related turn context, official fallback and visible clarification. Owner delegated factual review on 2026-09-22 in task Reload localhost. Eligible for the random mix: the starting criterion needs no game-specific components or role assignment. Label edit 2026-09-25: removed file/print bookkeeping from the edition label; rule content unchanged.
uncertainty: The answer applies to the identified publisher file; other editions may differ.
